title: "Unsupervised learning": Importance of N for t-test

cues.en: Instructor: So here we have another unsupervised learning project.
cues.zh: 講師：又有一個「非監督式學習」專題。

cues.en: Now, this one is a little bit more involved than most of the unsupervised learning challenges in this course.
cues.zh: 這次比課程中大多數挑戰稍微複雜。

cues.en: This one is a real project.
cues.zh: 是真正的專題。

cues.en: You're gonna have to write a bit of code, and the goal is to produce a figure that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 需要寫一些程式，目標是產生像這樣的圖。

cues.en: So what you are going to do here is explore the importance of sample size for the significance of a T-test in a two samples unpaired T-test.
cues.zh: 探索樣本數對兩獨立樣本、不成對 t 檢定顯著性的重要性。

cues.en: So here is what you wanna do.
cues.zh: 要做的事如下。

cues.en: You want to simulate some random data, such that group one has a mean of 1 and group two has a mean of 1.2.
cues.zh: 模擬隨機資料，第一組平均值為 1，第二組為 1.2。

cues.en: So you can see that these two, the means of these two groups are pretty close to each other.
cues.zh: 可以看到，兩組平均值相當接近。

cues.en: And then you start by simulating random numbers.
cues.zh: 先模擬隨機數。

cues.en: So Gaussian distributed random numbers with these two means for the two different groups.
cues.zh: 分別產生具有這兩個平均值的高斯分布隨機數。

cues.en: And a sample size of, let's see, what do I start with here?
cues.zh: 樣本大小，看看從哪裡開始？

cues.en: I guess that's around 10.
cues.zh: 大概是 10。

cues.en: So a sample size of 10, and that's 10 per group.
cues.zh: 樣本大小為 10，每組 10 個。

cues.en: So 20 samples in total, 10 in group one with the mean of 1, and 10 in group two with a mean of 2.
cues.zh: 總共 20 個，第一組 10 個、平均 1，第二組 10 個、平均 2。

cues.en: Okay, and then you run a T-test, a two samples T-test between those two groups and store the T value.
cues.zh: 再對兩組做雙樣本 t 檢定，儲存 t 值。

cues.en: That's what you wanna do, store the T value.
cues.zh: 要做的就是儲存 t 值。

cues.en: And then you run the experiment again using 11 data points in each group.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，每組用 11 個資料點。

cues.en: So a sample size of 11 in each group, and then you save the T value and then you run it again for 12, and so on, up to a sample size per group of 200,
cues.zh: 每組樣本大小為 11，儲存 t 值，再用 12，依此類推，每組一直到 200，

cues.en: which is what you see all the way at the end.
cues.zh: 就是最右端看到的。

cues.en: Now here's the thing.
cues.zh: 但有一點。

cues.en: Because we're stimulating data and because we are, we have sampling variability and so on, you know that the result of a single test is not necessarily so reliable.
cues.zh: 因為模擬資料、有抽樣變異等等，單次檢定不一定可靠。

cues.en: So therefore we want to repeat this multiple times.
cues.zh: 所以要重複多次。

cues.en: And that's what you see in all the gray lines.
cues.zh: 所有灰線顯示的就是這件事。

cues.en: So each of these gray lines here, they all get mashed together, just looks like a big noisy fuzz, but actually, it's a lot of gray lines together.
cues.zh: 每條灰線都混在一起，看起來像一大片吵雜絨毛，但其實有很多條。

cues.en: So I repeated the T-test, each time generating new data for, you know, 10 through 200 sample size.
cues.zh: 重複 t 檢定，每次針對 10 到 200 的樣本數產生新資料。

cues.en: And then I went back and I repeated it again, and I stored the T values again, and then again and again and again.
cues.zh: 再回頭重複一次，再儲存 t 值，反覆進行。

cues.en: And I did that 100 times.
cues.zh: 我做了 100 次。

cues.en: So 100 repetitions of each sample size.
cues.zh: 每種樣本數重複 100 次。

cues.en: And then what you see in the black line is the average across all of the different experiments from each individual sample size.
cues.zh: 黑線是每個樣本數下，所有不同實驗的平均值。

cues.en: And now it's pretty interesting to see that the mean, so the actual group differences, which means the numerator in the T-test is exactly the same,
cues.zh: 有趣的是，平均值、真正群組差異，也就是 t 檢定分子完全相同，

cues.en: plus sampling variability, which is why it's a little bit noisy.
cues.zh: 再加抽樣變異，所以稍有雜訊。

cues.en: But the expected value is the same.
cues.zh: 但期望值相同。

cues.en: And what's only changing is the sample size.
cues.zh: 唯一改變的是樣本數。

cues.en: So it's interesting to see that the T statistic is growing, it's getting larger and larger, even though the effect size is staying the same.
cues.zh: 因此很有趣，效果量不變，t 統計量卻逐漸變大。

cues.en: So the N is increasing.
cues.zh: N 在增加。

cues.en: Okay, and then what is this red line here?
cues.zh: 那紅線是什麼？

cues.en: So this red line is the T statistic that corresponds to a P value of 0.05.
cues.zh: 對應 P=0.05 的 t 統計量。

cues.en: And you can see that slowly get, it's a little bit subtle at this scale, but this red line is slowly getting smaller while the T value is getting larger.
cues.zh: 在這個尺度下有點不明顯，但紅線慢慢下降，而 t 值逐漸增加。

cues.en: Now, you're also gonna have to compute the P value separately for each one of these sample sizes.
cues.zh: 也必須針對每種樣本數，分別計算 P 值。

cues.en: And that's because the significance threshold for a T statistic depends on the degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 因為 t 統計量的顯著性門檻取決於自由度。

cues.en: And of course the degrees of freedom depends on the sample size.
cues.zh: 自由度當然取決於樣本大小。

cues.en: So you will need to have a different P value for each individual sample size here.
cues.zh: 所以每個樣本大小，需要不同的 P 值。

cues.en: Okay, so it's a pretty interesting result.
cues.zh: 結果相當有趣。

cues.en: But actually the main point of this unsupervised learning challenge is for you to be able to write code
cues.zh: 但這個挑戰主要重點，是讓你能撰寫程式，

cues.en: to run data simulations to be able to explore statistics.
cues.zh: 進行資料模擬，探索統計。

cues.en: So the point is not so much just to reproduce a graph that looks like this.
cues.zh: 不是只重現一張像這樣的圖。

cues.en: The point is for you to be able to develop the skill of simulating data to understand the sensitivities of different statistical tests.
cues.zh: 而是培養模擬資料的能力，理解不同統計檢定對各因素的敏感性。

cues.en: Do things like the mean differences.
cues.zh: 例如平均差。

cues.en: You know, once you have this code you can also start playing around with different effect sizes.
cues.zh: 有了程式，也能開始嘗試不同效果量。

cues.en: You can change the variance and see how that affects things and so on.
cues.zh: 改變變異數，看看影響等等。

cues.en: So good luck working through this coding challenge.
cues.zh: 祝你順利完成挑戰。

cues.en: I hope you find it both instructive and I hope you gain real practical skills that you can apply to other problems in statistics.
cues.zh: 希望有教學價值，也讓你取得真正實用的技巧，能套用到其他統計問題。
